title: NVIDIA agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA plans to buy Hugging Face
summary: NVIDIA says it will buy Hugging Face, the model, dataset and application platform used by more than 18 million people and 200,000 companies. NVIDIA says Hugging Face will remain open to models, clouds, frameworks and accelerators from across the ecosystem, without requiring NVIDIA compute.
friendlySummary: NVIDIA has agreed to pay $12.93 billion for Hugging Face, a large home for open AI models and datasets. It says the platform will continue to support other hardware and cloud providers.
whyItMatters: The deal places a central open-model distribution platform inside the leading AI-chip company. Developers should watch whether the stated hardware and cloud neutrality survives in product design, pricing and governance, while avoiding needless migration based only on the announcement.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Many developers depend on Hugging Face, so future changes could affect where they find and run AI models. For now, NVIDIA says the platform will stay open.
